en.Во время игры Windows не ставит драйверы: While you play, Windows does not install drivers through Windows Update, does not offer a restart and gives the game priority.
en.Штатная функция (Параметры → Игры → Игро: A built-in feature (Settings → Gaming → Game Mode), on by default — this item checks that nobody turned it off and turns it back on if needed. Average FPS gain in independent tests is about zero; the benefit is less background interference during play. On a Ryzen X3D with two CCDs, Game Mode is needed by the AMD driver to move the game to the cores with 3D cache. Undo it with UNDO in Lycoris or with the same switch in Settings.
en.Видеокарта сама управляет очередью своих: The graphics card manages the queue of its own tasks (HAGS). DLSS frame generation on GeForce RTX 40/50 does not work without it.
en.Параметры → Дисплей → Графика → «Аппарат: Settings → Display → Graphics → “Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling”. The effect on average FPS is within the margin of error (±5%), but DLSS Frame Generation and Multi Frame Generation require HAGS to be on. There are isolated complaints of stutter, VR and audio problems — if you notice them, undo this item. Takes effect after a restart.
en.По умолчанию включается только на GeForc: On by default only on GeForce RTX 40/50 with driver support. There is a separate optional item for other graphics cards.
en.Включает HAGS на видеокарте, драйвер кот: Turns on HAGS on a graphics card whose driver supports it (except RTX 40/50 — they have the main item).
The effect on FPS is within the margin of error. Some frame generation technologies require HAGS. On older graphics cards and in VR, stutter sometimes appears — then undo this item. Lycoris offers it only if the driver itself reports support. Takes effect after a restart.
en.Драйвер видеокарты не сообщает о поддерж: The graphics driver does not report support for hardware scheduling, or an RTX 40/50 is installed — it has the main item.
en.Отключить аппаратное планирование GPU (п: Disable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (for capture problems)
en.Выключает HAGS: лечение рывков и сбоев з: Turns HAGS off: a fix for stutter and capture failures in OBS and hardware encoders, not a speedup.
en.База знаний OBS называет HAGS причиной п: The OBS knowledge base names HAGS as a cause of performance problems and capture failures and advises turning it off as a diagnostic step. The price: DLSS Frame Generation / Multi Frame Generation on GeForce RTX 40/50 stop working. If HAGS was turned on by the driver default, Lycoris could not turn it off with undo before — now it can: undo removes the value (the driver default returns) or restores the previous one. Takes effect after a restart.
en.Драйвер не поддерживает аппаратное плани: The driver does not support hardware scheduling — there is nothing to disable.
en.Игры на DirectX 10/11 в оконном и безрам: DirectX 10/11 games in windowed and borderless mode switch to the modern presentation model (flip model).
en.Параметры → Дисплей → Графика → «Оптимиз: Settings → Display → Graphics → “Optimizations for windowed games”. According to Microsoft, this lowers presentation latency and lets VRR and Auto HDR work in a window. Lycoris changes only the SwapEffectUpgradeEnable flag in the DirectX settings string and leaves the other settings alone. Occasionally a single game shows screen tearing — you can exclude it in the same Settings page. Takes effect after the game restarts.
en.Windows включает VRR для игр DirectX 11,: Windows turns on VRR for DirectX 11 games that do not support G-SYNC/FreeSync on their own.
en.Работает, только если монитор и драйвер: Works only if the monitor and driver support variable refresh rate (G-SYNC / G-SYNC Compatible / FreeSync); on other monitors it changes nothing. Does not replace G-SYNC/FreeSync in the driver control panel. On some VA and OLED monitors, flicker on loading screens is possible — then undo this item. Takes effect after the game restarts.
en.Windows добавляет HDR играм DirectX 11/1: Windows adds HDR to DirectX 11/12 games that do not support it themselves. Works only on a monitor with HDR turned on.
en.Параметры → Дисплей → Графика → «Auto HD: Settings → Display → Graphics → “Auto HDR”. The strength can be set per game in Game Bar (Win+G → Settings → Gaming features → “Adjust HDR intensity”). Some games look oversaturated — then turn Auto HDR off for them in Game Bar or undo this item. Lycoris changes only the AutoHDREnable flag in the DirectX settings string and leaves the other settings alone. Takes effect from the next game launch.
en.Нужен включённый HDR хотя бы на одном мо: Requires HDR turned on for at least one monitor (Devices & network → Monitors) and Windows 11; for 24H2 — with update KB5051987 (February 2025) or newer.
en.Отключает «Записывать последние моменты»: Turns off “Record what happened” — constant background video recording while you play.
en.Фоновая запись непрерывно кодирует видео: Background recording continuously encodes video (NVENC/AMF) and takes video memory — that is 1–5% of FPS. In Windows 11 it is off by default, so this item mostly just confirms that. Manual recording (Win+Alt+R) and screenshots keep working.
en.Отключает захват видео и скриншотов чере: Turns off video and screenshot capture through Xbox Game Bar (Win+Alt+R, Win+Alt+PrtScn).
en.Оверлей Game Bar, игровой режим и распоз: The Game Bar overlay, Game Mode and game detection keep working. If you do not record anything, there is no gain — this item is for people who record video with another program and do not want accidental captures. Undo it with UNDO in Lycoris or in Settings → Gaming → Captures.
en.Исправляет мерцание, чёрные экраны и под: Fixes flicker, black screens and video stutter in the browser on systems with several monitors of different refresh rates.
A method from NVIDIA support (article 5157). This is a fix, not a speedup: without MPO, GPU load and latency rise in windowed and borderless modes. According to numerous reports, Windows 11 24H2 and newer ignores this key. Apply only if you have the described symptoms. Requires a restart.
en.Это исправление проблем с мерцанием, а н: This is a fix for flicker problems, not a speedup. Without MPO, graphics card load and latency in windowed games may increase. Turn it on only if you have flicker or black screens on several monitors.
en.драйвер видеокарты не поддерживает аппар: the graphics driver does not support hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
